s: October 29, 2024 - New Line Home Entertainment (formerly New Line Home Video) was the Home Video distribution arm of New Line Cinema. Founded in 1991 it was the successor to Nelson Entertainment's home video arm and would later acquire the production arm in 1992 and licensed most of its releases to Columbia TriStar Home Video until 1994 when its parent company was acquired by Ted Turner.
